# Gearo Hotbar

**Gearo Hotbar** is a clean and lightweight hotbar improvement mod for Minecraft.  
It is made to make item access feel smoother, faster, and more comfortable without changing the core style of the game.

## What it does

Gearo Hotbar improves the way you interact with your hotbar and item selection.  
Instead of relying only on the default setup, it gives you a more flexible and organized way to access important items during normal gameplay.

The mod is designed to feel natural, simple, and useful in everyday play. It does not try to replace Minecraft’s original style. It just makes the hotbar easier to use.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23afb40996634b153b3ad2d6cec6933790d8516f_0.webp)

## Features

- **Main UI access with a keybind**  
  Open the main interface with the default keybind **K**.

- **Custom keybind support**  
  The keybind can be changed in the controls menu, so you can use whatever key feels best for you.

- **Client-side mod**  
  Gearo Hotbar is made to run on the client side, so it can be used without requiring a full gameplay-side mod setup.

- **Server-friendly behavior**  
  The mod can still work on servers, as long as the server allows the normal client behavior needed for it.

- **Hotbar layout improvements**  
  Makes the hotbar feel more structured and easier to manage during regular play.

- **Faster item access**  
  Helps reduce the time spent switching through slots when you need something quickly.

- **Better organization**  
  Makes it easier to keep tools, blocks, food, and other important items in a clear order.

- **Smooth gameplay integration**  
  Stays close to the vanilla Minecraft experience instead of adding a heavy or distracting UI.

- **Lightweight design**  
  Focuses on being simple and efficient, without unnecessary clutter.

## Game modes

Gearo Hotbar is not only useful in Creative mode.  
It also works well in **Survival**, especially when you already have the items you need and want to access them faster and more cleanly.

It is useful for:

- Building
- Mining
- Exploring
- Combat
- Redstone work
- General survival gameplay
- Creative building

## Experience

The goal of Gearo Hotbar is to make item handling feel more comfortable and practical.  
It is made for players who want a cleaner workflow and a better way to reach their important items without breaking the normal Minecraft feel.

Everything is kept straightforward, so the mod feels easy to use in normal play.

## Summary

Gearo Hotbar is a lightweight hotbar improvement mod that makes item access simpler and more organized.  
It includes a configurable **K** keybind for the main UI, works client-side, and can be used on servers where client behavior is allowed.  
It is useful in both Creative and Survival, depending on what items you already have and how you want to manage them.
